# Fixtures

The four canonical fixtures are copies from Tinker's `testdata/`, generated by
`cargo run -p tinker-core --example gen-fixtures` (MuPDF-written; provenance
matters because tinker-pdf must OPEN foreign files, and until phase 12 it
cannot generate its own). Passwords: encrypted-aes256.pdf user `open-sesame`,
owner `owner-secret`; permissions-noprint.pdf user `user`, owner `owner`
(/P -2056: printing denied). These are the parity fixtures for
`tinker_parity.rs`; do not modify them, regenerate in Tinker if ever needed.
